tagline: Leading homebuilder delivering quality homes with strong capital returns
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary revenue generator for the company with $3.4 billion in 2025, directly reflecting real estate market performance and the homebuilder's operational execution

kpis.name: Home sales revenue
kpis.description: Home sales revenue declined in 2025 due to economic conditions and volatility in consumer sentiment

kpis.name: Construction gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin on home sales, calculated as (home sales revenue minus cost of sales) divided by home sales revenue
kpis.description: Construction gross margin decreased in 2025 to 21.0% from 23.1% in 2024 due to elevated construction costs and competitive pressure

kpis.name: Net income attributable to common shareholders
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to common shareholders after interest and taxes
kpis.description: Net income declined 47.4% in 2025 to $241.1 million due to lower order volumes and margin pressure

kpis.name: Total liquidity
kpis.explanation: Available cash plus unused borrowing capacity
kpis.description: Total cash and borrowing capacities totaled $1.8 billion as of December 31, 2025, comprised of $982.8 million in cash and $798.1 million in unused capacity

kpis.name: Diluted earnings per share
kpis.explanation: Net income per diluted common share outstanding
kpis.description: Diluted EPS decreased 43.7% in 2025 to $2.72 compared to $4.83 in 2024

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 6 reported fiscal years (10-K)
kpis.signal: Revenue of $3.26B in latest fiscal year (FY2020)

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K)
kpis.signal: Operating income of $0.302B in latest fiscal year (FY2025)

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K)
kpis.signal: Total assets of $4.978B in latest fiscal year (FY2025)

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions board and audit committee oversight of cybersecurity risks, as well as the CIO's role. The language intensity is moderate but the topic is recurring. The context shows heightened attention to this risk

risks.title: Litigation and regulatory proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that lawsuits and regulatory proceedings are ongoing or may be initiated, with uncertainty regarding outcomes and risk of material harm. The language is cautious and the subject is addressed in a dedicated section

risks.title: Real estate market volatility and consumer sentiment volatility
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes consumer sentiment volatility, the impact of elevated prices and mortgage rates on affordability, and demand fluctuation. The sales performance analysis shows a significant decline in orders of 23.4%

risks.title: Merger and acquisition strategy risks
risks.score_rationale: The announcement of a merger agreement with Sumitomo involves significant costs and conditions precedent (regulatory and shareholder approvals). The risk of change of control triggering under credit facilities and mortgage loan repurchase agreements is mentioned

risks.title: Inventory management and production alignment risks
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions the need to moderate speculative inventory and align construction starts with demand to manage risks. The data shows a decline in orders and absorption rates

risks.title: Share repurchase program risks
risks.score_rationale: The share repurchase program is discretionary and may be modified or suspended. In 2025, the company repurchased 8.5 million shares for $277.2 million. While intended to return value to shareholders, it represents a financial commitment that may be redirected
